a.text: Honest concern: with an 80% storm chance each round, our plan (operate twice, then take) only works if two storms in a row miss, about a 4% chance for each of us. The reserve has exactly 4 now, enough for one of us. I won't take without your agreement. Do you want to keep the original plan or renegotiate? Tell me your preference and I'll respond openly.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: Understood. I'll keep our agreement: operating now, and we each take 4 once the reserve reaches 8.
